name: SuperMart Downtown Flagship
address: 100 Market Street, City Center, Metro City

departments.customer_service_desk: Open during all store operating hours

amenities: Underground Parking (Free 2 hours for shoppers with receipt over $15, 150 stalls)
Click & Collect dedicated bays at Bay 1 to 4
Wheelchair accessible entrances and motorized carts

policies.returns: Returns accepted within 14 days with original receipt for non-perishable unopened goods. Perishable items (meat, produce, dairy) must be reported within 24 hours at the in-store customer service desk. Chat agent cannot issue cash refunds directly.
policies.pets: Service animals welcome. Non-service pets are not permitted due to public food safety regulations.

name: SuperMart Westside Suburban
amenities: EV Charging Stations (4 Tesla, 4 Universal ChargePoint)

policies.returns: Standard 14-day return policy at customer service desk with receipt.
